0F29.name: Score digit tiles
0F29.kind: byte table, one tile per digit (index X)
desc: Tile numbers for the score digits shown on the status bar. The status bar routine converts the score into
digits here, then blanks leading zeros and copies the tiles to the status bar tilemap.

0F30.name: Level timer frame countdown
desc: Frames until the next tick of the level timer. Reloaded with $28 (about 40 frames) by the status bar
routine each time it ticks the clock down, and set to $28 when the initial status bar is uploaded.
Values: 0 = decrement the timer digits and reload $28.

0F31.name: Level timer hundreds digit
desc: Hundreds digit of the level timer. $0F32 is the tens digit and $0F33 the ones digit. Set from the level
header, cleared in bonus rooms and at Time Up, decremented by the status bar routine and carried into by
Yoshi's tongue code (the Yoshi berry time bonus). Read for the status bar, the time bonus tally
($05:CE4E) and the death/Time Up check.

0F32.name: Level timer tens digit
desc: Tens digit of the level timer ($0F31 is hundreds, $0F33 ones). Zeroed by the level header parse when the
header timer is 0 or by bonus game setup, counted down by the status bar routine, and read by the Time Up
check and the level end tally.

0F33.name: Level timer ones digit
desc: Ones digit of the level timer ($0F31 hundreds, $0F32 tens). Cleared for bonus games (time = 000) and by
the level header parse; counted down by the status bar routine; read by the Time Up check and the end of
level time bonus.

0F34.name: Player score, low byte
0F34.kind: byte table, 3 bytes per player (index X = 0 or 3)
desc: Low byte of a player's 24-bit score, in units of 10 points. $0F35 is the middle and $0F36 the high byte.
Added to by score sprites, breaking turn blocks and the end of level bonus tally; cleared when a new game
starts; the status bar routine clamps it to $0F423F (999,999 after x10) and draws it.

0F35.name: Player score, middle byte
0F35.kind: byte table, 3 bytes per player (index X)
desc: Middle byte of the 24-bit score in units of 10 points ($0F34 is the low byte, $0F36 the high byte).
Incremented as a carry by turn block breaking and the bonus tally; read by score sprites and the status
bar.

0F36.name: Player score, high byte
0F36.kind: byte table, 3 bytes per player (index X)
desc: High byte of the 24-bit score in units of 10 points ($0F34 low, $0F35 middle). Receives the carry from
the middle byte in score sprites, turn block breaking and the bonus tally; cleared at new game; read by
the status bar to show the score.

0F40.name: Remaining time bonus
desc: Working copy of the time bonus counter in the end of level tally. Set from a scratch value when the tally
starts and counted down by the course clear state that adds the bonus to the score (rewarding 1 or 10 at
a time).

0F48.name: Bonus stars per player
0F48.kind: byte table indexed by player (X = 0 or 1)
desc: Bonus star count for each player. Cleared on game start, incremented by the course clear tally when the
player earns stars, read by the status bar for the bonus star display and by the level end tally to
trigger the bonus game.

0F4A.name: Cluster / flame misc table
0F4A.kind: byte table, one per cluster or extended sprite slot
desc: General per-slot byte used by several cluster-type effects, meaning depends on the effect. Examples: Sumo
Bro lightning flame timer (starts at $7F), castle candle flame animation counter, Boo/bat ceiling sway
direction, and a copy of X position low or an X*4 phase offset for newly spawned cluster sprites.

0F72.name: Cluster sprite group index
0F72.kind: byte table, one per cluster sprite slot
desc: Index of a cluster sprite within its spawn group (loaded from $000E when spawned). The ring of Boos and
the Boo/bat ceiling routines use it to offset each member's position and timing.

0F86.name: Cluster sprite state / ring number
0F86.kind: byte table, one per cluster sprite slot
desc: Cleared when cluster sprites spawn. For ceiling Boos/bats it is incremented to 1 to wake the slot; for a
ring of Boos it holds the ring number of that Boo (used to index the ring tables $0FAE-$0FBA). Also read
by Banzai Bill code.

0F9A.name: Cluster sprite delay timer
0F9A.kind: byte table, one per cluster sprite slot
desc: Delay before a ceiling Boo/bat swoops down. Set to $20 frames when the slot is woken by the Boo/bat
ceiling code.

0FAE.name: Ring of Boos angle, low byte
0FAE.kind: byte table indexed by ring number
desc: Low byte of the 9-bit rotation angle of each ring of Boos. Increased by the ring's speed each frame;
$0FB0 holds the ninth bit.

0FB0.name: Ring of Boos angle, high bit
0FB0.kind: byte table indexed by ring number
desc: Bit 0 is the ninth bit of the ring angle ($0FAE is the low byte); updated with the carry from the speed
add.

0FB2.name: Ring of Boos screen boundary low
0FB2.kind: byte table indexed by ring number
desc: Low byte of the adjusted screen boundary used by each ring of Boos, stored at load by the cluster loader
and read by the ring routine ($0FB4 is the high byte).

0FB4.name: Ring of Boos screen boundary high
0FB4.kind: byte table indexed by ring number
desc: High byte of the adjusted screen boundary for each ring of Boos ($0FB2 is the low byte). Stored at
cluster load, read by the ring routine.

0FBA.name: Ring of Boos despawned flag
0FBA.kind: flag byte table indexed by ring number
desc: Cleared to 0 when a ring is loaded. The ring of Boos routine reads it to tell whether that ring has been
despawned.

0FBE.name: Map16 tile definition pointers
desc: Table of 16-bit addresses of tile definitions. Filled by level load and Map16 pointer setup, read when
building Map16 tiles, layer 2 updates, credits backgrounds, and the overworld layers, where it points at
each tile definition.

13BE.name: Item memory setting
desc: Which item memory table the level uses, taken from the top two bits of level header byte 5. Used when
drawing coins, midway/goal gates and other objects to find the item memory bytes for this level.

13BF.name: Translevel number
desc: Number of the level currently loaded (the translevel number, not the overworld tile). Set during level
load and read by many routines to special-case certain levels: tile interaction, Dry Bones, cutscene
check, message box, overworld return.

13C1.name: Overworld tile under player
desc: Overworld tile number Mario is standing on (the current map tile). Set by the overworld setup, read by
the walking, level entry, pipe, star warp and event code and by overworld sprites.

13C3.name: Current player submap
desc: Submap (overworld map number) of the active player. Stored by overworld setup code from $1F11+X and OR'd
back into $1F11 when switching maps in submap transitions.

13C6.name: Cutscene / level end state
desc: Counter/flag set by bosses and the goal to start the end of level sequence, and cutscene number for the
castle scenes and credits (1-7 castle scenes, 8 = credits). Incremented when a boss dies or goal is hit,
decremented by Reznor ring to stop Mario walking. Read by NMI, the Mario animation code, Yoshi and
overworld load.

13C7.name: Yoshi color
desc: Color of the Yoshi Mario owns or is riding (the palette selection). Set when Mario gets on Yoshi and
copied to and from the player's saved Yoshi color when entering or leaving levels.

13C9.name: Continue/End menu flag
desc: Non-zero while the CONTINUE/END menu is active after Game Over. Incremented when both players are out of
lives and to enter the menu state, cleared when a game starts, and read when loading the overworld to
skip ahead unless returning from it.

13CA.name: Save pending flag
desc: Incremented by the overworld after-level routine to flag that the game should be saved, tested later in
overworld processing.

13CB.name: Give Mario star flag
desc: Bit 7 gives Mario a star when tested by the per-frame Mario state code, which then clears it. Incremented
when a level-end sprite is converted to a bonus powerup and shifted left at level start; the purpose of
the shift is unclear.

13CC.name: Coins to add
desc: Pending coins to add to the coin counter. Switch icon and coin counter code add to it, and the status bar
routine takes one coin off per frame (decrementing it) and adds it to the displayed total.

13CE.name: Midway point reached flag
desc: Set to 1 when Mario passes the midway gate or finishes a level cleared by the message box; cleared when a
level loads. Tested by midway point drawing and overworld level exit code. Probably the midway/level
cleared flag.

13CF.name: Midway entry flag
desc: Cleared when a level loads and may be set when entering from a midway point. Read by level start setup to
choose the start position.

13D0.name: Overworld event tile kind
desc: Kind of tile an overworld event draws (stored by the event state machine) and read by the code that
writes the event tile blocks into the stripe image.

13D2.name: Switch palace event flag
desc: Set to 1 when Mario presses a switch, used with $13C6 to choose the scripted walk, and as a Switch Palace
message flag by the message box (X + 1). Cleared to 0 when the ! block particle effect finishes.

13D3.name: Pause delay timer
desc: Frames before the game may be paused again. Set to $3C on pause and counted down each frame in the level;
the byte is also the start of the area cleared on overworld load.

13D4.name: Pause flag
desc: In levels, non-zero while the game is paused. On the overworld, set while looking around the map with the
L/R buttons and cleared with 0 when leaving that mode.

13D5.name: Layer 3 / scroll-sprite stop flag
desc: Non-zero while layer 3 effects such as the message box or end of level tally are active; the scroll
routines read it to stop scroll sprites. Cleared at level start, incremented when there is no animated
layer 3, set to 1 by the message box and tally.

13D6.name: Level start / tally delay timer
desc: Countdown set to $50 at level start and $30 between course clear states. Decremented by the bonus star
line state.

13D9.name: Overworld process
desc: Overworld state machine number. 0 = stop overworld processing, 3 = normal control, 4/5 = after-level
save, 8 = Mario walks along the path, $0B = star warp, $0C = special event. Read by NMI, palette upload,
overworld sprites and drawing.

13DA.name: X speed fraction
desc: Fractional bits of Mario's X speed, kept for sub-pixel movement. Cleared when climbing and written by
collision code; used by the Mario movement code with ADC to carry the fraction.

13DB.name: Mario walk frame
desc: Mario's walking animation frame number. Set when finishing the pose and read by the walk animation
counter, the OAM drawer and cape/accessory drawing, which index tables by it.

13DD.name: Mario turning direction
desc: Non-zero while Mario is turning around on the ground; set to $0D to show the turn-around pose, cleared by
normal animation. Read by pose choice, carried item and kick code.

13DE.name: Mario pose offset
desc: Offset added to the walking pose frame (walking, running, ...) by the pose finish code. Cleared by
scripted animations, pipes and normal animation when there is no cape interaction.

13DF.name: Cape image
desc: Index of the cape animation frame. Updated by the cape image routines and pose choice from a table,
cleared for pipes and climbing, and read by the Mario OAM drawing.

13E0.name: Mario pose
desc: Mario's current image (pose) number. Written by the animation routines (pipe $0F, death $3E, peace sign
$26, flower power-up 0, etc.) and read by the OAM drawing and cape tables to choose tiles.
